mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tight monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a recessionary risk that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 AND INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising by >0.5% over the past 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% AND FEDFUNDS increased by >0.5% in the past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and increased by >0.5% in the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a supply shock that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past 1 month (measured by the 1-month change in UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.2pp in the past 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over the past 3 months (measured by the 3-month change in INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
